stations.title: Card machine
stations.text: Thinks for a moment before it says yes.

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: Steps run before the last ends

captions: Promises work. At the market, Ines wants the laptop to ring up two sage candles.
Without waiting, the candles leave the shelf before the card machine has said yes.
You write the waiting as plain lines with async and await, one step after another.
The card machine says yes, then the candles come off the shelf: paid, and 7 left.
Waiting code reads top to bottom now, with a decision wherever it is needed.
